references.text: The Lord's command to devote (kherem) everything belonging to Canaanite cities, including people and animals.
The law of devoting all who live in the cities that the Lord gives to the Israelites, where no living thing is to be spared.
Samuel commands Saul to completely devote the Amalekites - men and women, children and infants, oxen and sheep, camels and donkeys.
Israel vows to devote the Canaanite cities, and the Lord gives them victory over the Canaanites.
The Israelites devoted the cities of King Sihon - men, women, and children - no survivors were spared.
Devotion of the cities of King Og in Bashan, as was done with Sihon, where all the inhabitants were killed.
Joshua's destruction of Ai, where all the inhabitants were put to the sword - a similar devotion.
Joshua captures Makkedah and devotes all its inhabitants to the sword, just as he did with Jericho.
Joshua's conquest of Hazor and the surrounding cities, where everyone was put to the sword and devoted.
